maudhui: (1) In this Constitution, unless the context otherwise requires, expressions used include definitions relating to military orders and members of the armed forces; the House of Representatives; Parliament; political parties; the Chief Justice and Chief Justice of Zanzibar; armed forces; the Commonwealth; oaths and the oath of allegiance; judicial ethics; offices in the service of the Government of the United Republic; courts and High Courts; Union Matters; State Authority; the Attorney General; Government; local government authorities; Mainland Tanzania; Tanzania Zanzibar; general elections; Ujamaa and Self-Reliance; Ministers; and Zanzibar, as specified in the constitutional text. (2) For purposes of interpreting this Constitution: (a) references to powers of the President include authority and duties exercised as Head of the Government of the United Republic and other powers and duties vested in the President by this Constitution or other law; (b) references to public service offices and Government departments mean those of the Government of the United Republic unless otherwise stated; (c) where this Constitution requires a political party to perform or deal with a matter, it shall do so according to its procedures and subject to this Constitution and any relevant law enacted by Parliament; (d) receipt of a pension or similar benefit for former service does not by itself constitute holding an office in the service of the Government of the United Republic; (e) a reference to the holder of an office includes a person lawfully acting in or appointed to hold that office, unless the context otherwise requires; (f) a power to remove a person from public office includes a power conferred by law requiring or permitting retirement, but does not authorize compulsory retirement of a Justice of Appeal, Judge of the High Court or Controller and Auditor-General contrary to this Constitution; and (g) a reference to a law altering or repealing another law includes a law amending, continuing, replacing or re-enacting that other law, with or without modification.
